name: lookup_company
description: Look up a Danish company in the official CVR register (Erhvervsstyrelsen, Det Centrale Virksomhedsregister) by company name or 8-digit CVR number. Returns the single best-match record: name, vat (CVR number), address, zipcode, city, phone, email, employees, industrycode/industrydesc, companycode/companydesc (company form, e.g. A/S), startdate, enddate, status, productionunits. No match returns found:false. e.g. {query:"novo nordisk"} or {query:"24256790"}.

query.description: Company name or 8-digit CVR number. e.g. "novo nordisk" or "24256790".

name: lookup_by_vat
description: Look up a Danish company by its explicit 8-digit CVR/VAT number in the CVR register (Erhvervsstyrelsen). Same fields as lookup_company. e.g. {vat:"24256790"} (Novo Nordisk A/S).
